```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{R cincy_crashes}
crashes_per_day = 30125 / 365
crashes_per_day

crashes_by_day = c(2020, 2241, 2327, 2285,
                   2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day

crashes_by_day > 2000        # seven answers

sum(crashes_by_day > 2000)   # days above 2,000

mean(crashes_by_day)
```

## Type of `crashes_per_day`
```{r}
typeof(crashes_by_day)

crashes_by_day = c(2020L, 2241L, 2327L, 2285L,
                   2380L, 1866L, 1664L)
```
